item.title: Supported Sensors
item.description:
Beta

Overview

Microsoft Places consumes occupancy data to power room availability, automatic room release, desk booking, and workspace analytics. Microsoft Places focuses strictly on workspace utilization, desk and room booking, and hybrid work coordination — using signals like Teams devices and standard occupancy sensors.

This page explains which Haltian sensor is supported for Microsoft Places, how it maps to Places resources, and how to deploy it for each scenario.

item.title: Frequently Asked Questions
item.description:
Beta

General

What is the Microsoft Places integration?

The Haltian IoT integration for Microsoft Places feeds real-time sensor occupancy data from physical sensors into the Microsoft Places platform. This enables features like sensor-verified room availability in Places Finder, automatic room release for ghost bookings, sensor-confirmed desk status, and data-driven workspace analytics — all within Microsoft Teams and Outlook.

Which Microsoft 365 licenses do I need?

As of April 1, 2026, individual desk booking, autorelease, and occupancy reports moved from a per-user Teams Premium license to a per-space licensing model. Customers with active Teams Premium subscriptions purchased before that date keep these features until renewal.
